tldr: 台積電領軍半導體走強，加權指數攻上波段新高，市場聚焦9月30日台積電台灣技術論壇。
玉山金完成併購三商美邦人壽，躍居第五大上市金控；金管會協助壽險業平穩接軌新制。
台灣高資產財富預估年均成長約一成，超高資產客群境外配置持續加深。
台灣央行維持利率但操作偏緊，通膨略超2%警戒；主計總處因AI帶動出口大幅上修成長。
美股走弱，美債殖利率攀多年新高（30年期破5.6%），Fed決策在即；油價因中東情勢走高。

items.title_zh: 半導體領漲 加權指數攻上兩個半月新高
items.title_en: Semiconductors power TAIEX to a multi-week high as TSMC leads
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數強勢上攻，單日大漲約775點，改寫近兩個半月新高，權值半導體族群走強、台積電領軍衝鋒。這波以科技股為主的漲勢反映市場risk appetite回穩、資金重返大型股，但指數高度集中於少數晶片權值股，一旦AI相關需求或市場情緒生變，指數波動風險仍不容忽視，投資人須留意集中度過高的隱憂。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rallied sharply, climbing around 775 points to its highest level in about two and a half months, driven by strength in heavyweight semiconductor names with TSMC at the front of the charge. The broad-based tech advance signals resilient risk appetite, though the index's heavy reliance on a handful of chip giants keeps it exposed to swings in AI-related demand and sentiment.

items.title_zh: 台積電再創新高 法人：2026成長動能不只AI
items.title_en: TSMC hits fresh record as analysts see 2026 growth beyond AI
items.summary_zh: 台積電股價再攀歷史新高，法人指出公司2026年成長動能不僅來自AI，更擴及高效能運算與先進製程的整體需求，訂單能見度佳。此看法鞏固市場對台灣晶片供應鏈的樂觀預期；惟台積電指數權重龐大，股價上漲雖同步推升大盤，卻也使指數型基金與ETF投資人的單一個股風險同步放大，追高時須審慎評估。
items.summary_en: TSMC's shares scaled a new all-time high, with institutional investors arguing the company's 2026 growth momentum extends beyond artificial intelligence into broader high-performance computing and advanced-node demand. The call underpins bullish expectations for Taiwan's chip supply chain, but with TSMC commanding an outsized index weight, its rally simultaneously lifts the market and concentrates single-stock risk for index and ETF holders.

items.title_zh: 台積電技術論壇台灣場登場 聚焦2奈米與先進封裝
items.title_en: TSMC holds Taiwan technology forum with 2nm and advanced packaging in focus
items.summary_zh: 台積電9月30日以線上線下混合模式舉辦技術論壇台灣場次，展示最新製程藍圖。市場關注是否釋出更多2奈米量產進度、先進封裝產能擴張及開放創新平台生態系的訊息。若釋出正向展望，將進一步鞏固台灣在先進製程的領先地位，並支撐國內晶片設備、材料供應鏈的資本支出動能延續，帶動相關供應鏈題材。
items.summary_en: TSMC stages the Taiwan leg of its technology symposium on Sept 30 in a hybrid online-offline format, spotlighting its latest process roadmap. Investors are watching for fresh detail on the 2-nanometer node ramp, advanced packaging capacity and its open-innovation platform ecosystem. Any upbeat guidance would reinforce Taiwan's leading-edge dominance and support sustained capex across the domestic chip equipment and materials supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電2026營收估成長逾三成 資本支出上看560億美元
items.title_en: TSMC seen growing 2026 revenue over 30% with capex near US$56bn
items.summary_zh: 法人預估台積電2026年營收成長率將「超過」30%，資本支出同步衝高至約560億美元，反映先進製程與AI需求持續強勁。積極的資本支出計畫顯示公司對多年期訂單能見度深具信心，鞏固台灣在全球AI硬體建置的核心地位；但也墊高供應鏈門檻，並使台灣經濟成長更集中於單一、資本密集的產業循環，須留意景氣循環風險。
items.summary_en: Analysts project TSMC's 2026 revenue growth to exceed 30%, with capital expenditure climbing toward roughly US$56 billion as leading-edge and AI demand stays robust. The aggressive spending plan signals confidence in multi-year order visibility and cements Taiwan's role at the core of the global AI hardware buildout, while raising the bar for suppliers and reinforcing the island's economic dependence on a single, capital-intensive cycle.

items.title_zh: 玉山金完成併購三商美邦人壽 躍居第五大上市金控
items.title_en: E.Sun Financial completes Mercuries Life takeover to become fifth-largest listed holdco
items.summary_zh: 玉山金控正式完成成立33年的三商美邦人壽併購案，將其納為子公司。此案使玉山金從以「銀行」為單一核心，轉型為兼具銀行、壽險、證券三大支柱的綜合型金控，總資產規模突破6.5兆元，躍升為國內第五大上市金控。此併購重塑中型金控競爭版圖，也牽動壽險市場市占與後續整併態勢，市場關注其綜效發揮與資本配置成效。
items.summary_en: E.Sun Financial has finalized its acquisition of Mercuries Life, folding the 33-year-old insurer in as a subsidiary. The deal transforms E.Sun from a bank-centric group into a diversified holding company spanning banking, life insurance and securities, lifting total assets past NT$6.5 trillion and making it Taiwan's fifth-largest listed financial holding company. The move reshapes the competitive map among mid-tier holdcos.

items.title_zh: 金管會三面向強化壽險體質 引導資金投入國內公建
items.title_en: FSC moves on three fronts to shore up life insurers ahead of 2026 transition
items.summary_zh: 因應壽險業2026年接軌IFRS 17與新一代清償能力制度，金管會從資產、負債、淨值三大面向同步引導業者調整，強化財務體質。金管會並研議引導保險資金投入國內公共建設的管道，惟坦言涉及跨部會協調，仍需時間推動。相關安排旨在緩衝接軌期間的資本波動，穩定壽險體系，兼顧安全與長期發展並進的政策方向。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan's life insurers due to adopt IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency regime in 2026, the FSC is pressing measures on three fronts—assets, liabilities and net worth—to strengthen the sector's financial footing. Regulators are also studying channels to steer insurance funds into domestic public-infrastructure projects, though cross-agency coordination will take time. The framework aims to cushion capital swings during the changeover.

items.title_zh: 台灣高資產財富估年均成長約一成 直至2029年
items.title_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth wealth seen growing ~10% a year through 2029
items.summary_zh: KPMG報告預估，台灣高資產客群個人財富總額2025至2029年將以年均約10%成長，人數由約12.3萬人增至15.5萬人；其中10億級超高資產客群成長更快，預估由8,000人增至1.1萬人，速度明顯高於整體。此趨勢反映高資產家族對私人銀行、信託及跨境財富架構需求升溫，帶動財管業者積極布局頂端客群，深化跨世代傳承與海外配置服務。
items.summary_en: A KPMG study projects the personal wealth of Taiwan's high-net-worth individuals to expand at roughly 10% annually from 2025 to 2029, with the population rising from about 123,000 to 155,000. The billion-NT-dollar ultra-rich tier is set to grow faster, from around 8,000 to 11,000 people. The findings point to swelling demand for private banking, trusts and cross-border wealth structures as affluent families diversify.

items.title_zh: 台新銀行奪財管三大獎 私銀競爭白熱化
items.title_en: Taishin sweeps top wealth-management honors as private-banking rivalry heats up
items.summary_zh: 台新銀行在2026年《財訊》財富管理大獎中一舉奪下「最佳財富管理」、「最佳財富增值」與「最佳私人銀行」三項大獎；中國信託銀行則拿下「最佳AI應用私人銀行」與「最佳數位化客戶體驗私人銀行」。獎項結果凸顯台灣各銀行搶攻高資產客群競爭白熱化，業者透過跨世代傳承規劃、海外商品與AI智能顧問服務深化差異化，爭取頂端財富客戶的錢包份額。
items.summary_en: Taishin Bank claimed a trio of top prizes—best wealth management, best wealth appreciation and best private bank—in the 2026 Wealth Magazine awards, while CTBC Bank took best AI-application private bank and best digital private-banking client experience. The results underscore intensifying competition among Taiwan's lenders to win high-net-worth clients through cross-generational succession planning, offshore products and AI-driven advisory services.

items.title_zh: 擬制遺產課稅修法 過世前2年贈與併入遺產由受贈人負擔
items.title_en: Taiwan tightens rules on "deemed estate" gifts made before death
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過「擬制遺產」課稅方式修正，明定往生者過世前2年內贈與親屬的財產，將併入遺產總額課稅，並由受贈人單獨承擔該部分稅負，不再由全體繼承人分攤；財政部同步規劃後續稽徵作業。此修法堵住生前贈與規避遺產稅的空間、調整納稅義務歸屬，將促使高資產家庭重新檢視生前贈與的時點與架構，審慎規劃財富傳承節奏以免衍生額外稅負。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's legislature has advanced changes to how pre-death gifts are taxed: assets gifted to relatives within two years before death will be folded into the taxable estate, with the recipient—rather than all heirs collectively—bearing that portion of the estate tax. The finance ministry is preparing follow-up assessment procedures. The reform closes a planning loophole and shifts liability, prompting families to revisit lifetime-gifting timing.

items.title_zh: CFC申報進入數據驗收期 稅局交叉比對強化查核
items.title_en: CFC reporting enters a data-verification phase as authorities cross-check filings
items.summary_zh: 2026年是CFC（受控外國企業）申報制度的重要轉折點。台灣自2023年實施CFC以來，稅捐稽徵機關已累積兩年申報資料，透過交叉比對與查核模型，稅務環境正式進入「數據驗收期」。過往部分投資人抱持「海外資金未匯回即免稅」或「未申報就不需繳稅」的迷思，在現行制度下已不再適用。持有境外公司架構的投資人應正視申報義務，避免補稅與裁罰風險升高。
items.summary_en: 2026 marks a turning point for Taiwan's controlled-foreign-company (CFC) regime. Having accumulated two years of filings since the rules took effect in 2023, the tax authority is now cross-matching data and applying audit models, moving into a verification phase. Old assumptions—that undistributed offshore funds or unreported income escape tax—no longer hold, raising compliance risk for investors with overseas structures.

items.title_zh: 央行按兵不動、操作偏緊 通膨略超2%警戒區
items.title_en: Central bank holds rates and leans tight as inflation runs above its 2% guard line
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行於季度理監事會維持政策利率不變，並在上修通膨預測後，釋出貨幣操作「偏緊」訊號。總裁楊金龍指出，消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率略高於2%的警戒門檻，但表示「還有時間觀察」。央行在維持利率的同時示警物價壓力，保留了若通膨僵固則進一步緊縮的空間；市場解讀央行對通膨的關注升溫，後續資金環境是否轉向仍待觀察。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank kept its policy rate unchanged at its quarterly board meeting, signaling a monetary stance tilted toward the tight side after upgrading its inflation forecasts. Governor Yang Chin-long noted CPI running slightly above the 2% warning threshold, saying there is still time to observe. Holding steady while flagging price pressure keeps the door open to further tightening if inflation proves sticky.

items.title_zh: 主計總處大幅上修全年GDP AI題材帶動出口投資雙旺
items.title_en: Officials upgrade Taiwan's growth outlook as AI-driven exports and investment surge
items.summary_zh: 主計總處大幅上修全年經濟成長率（GDP）預測，指出受惠AI等新興科技應用商機持續熱絡，出口大幅成長，民間投資擴增、民間消費亦持續成長，帶動整體景氣走強。科技供應鏈強勁的訂單動能是本次上修的主要支撐。成長動能轉強，強化央行審慎看待通膨的立場；惟台灣經濟愈發綁定AI投資循環，一旦該題材需求生變，成長恐面臨較大回檔風險，須留意景氣過度集中。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's statistics agency has sharply lifted its full-year GDP forecast, citing booming AI-related demand that has powered exports, private investment and consumption. Robust order momentum across the tech supply chain is underpinning the upgrade. The stronger growth trajectory reinforces the case for a cautious central bank, but leaves the economy increasingly tied to the AI investment cycle and vulnerable to any downturn in that theme.

items.title_zh: 油價跳升、道瓊重挫 市場靜候Fed利率決策
items.title_en: Oil jumps and Dow slides as markets await the Fed's rate decision
items.summary_zh: 全球市場轉趨審慎，投資人靜候聯準會（Fed）利率決策，道瓊工業指數盤中重挫逾800點。國際油價跳升，布蘭特原油一度逼近每桶90美元，一反過去數日跌勢，主因中東地緣情勢再度升溫。能源成本走高疊加利率決策不確定性，壓抑股市表現，並強化市場對通膨僵固、Fed恐維持鷹派路徑的預期，避險情緒升溫，資金流向趨於保守。
items.summary_en: Global markets turned cautious as investors braced for the Federal Reserve's rate decision, with the Dow Jones falling sharply. Crude prices jumped—Brent pushing toward US$90 a barrel—reversing a multi-day slide amid renewed geopolitical tension in the Middle East. The combination of higher energy costs and rate-decision uncertainty pressured equities, feeding expectations that persistent inflation could keep the Fed on a hawkish path.

items.title_zh: 美股回檔拖累台股早盤跳水 費半重挫半導體承壓
items.title_en: US pullback drags Taiwan shares lower at the open as chip stocks bear the brunt
items.summary_zh: 美股回檔情緒外溢至台北股市，台股早盤跳水、跌勢明顯，費城半導體指數走弱重挫本地晶片權值股。美國科技股情緒與台灣以半導體為主的指數高度連動，使台股易受海外波動牽引。此波下殺凸顯台股對華爾街走向與全球利率預期的高度敏感，資金在AI題材與升息疑慮間拉鋸，短線震盪加劇，投資人須留意國際盤面變化。
items.summary_en: A retreat on Wall Street spilled into Taipei, sending Taiwan stocks sharply lower in early trade, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index's weakness weighing heavily on local chip names. The tight linkage between US tech sentiment and Taiwan's semiconductor-heavy index left the market exposed to overseas swings. The episode highlights how sensitive Taiwan equities remain to Wall Street's direction and global rate expectations.

items.title_zh: 美股收黑 美債殖利率再攀多年新高（2026-09-29）
items.title_en: US stocks slip as Treasury yields hit fresh multiyear highs (2026-09-29)
items.summary_zh: 美股週二收黑，美國公債殖利率再度攀升至多年新高，在Fed利率決策前壓抑風險偏好。此波走勢延續了由通膨僵固與政府龐大舉債所驅動的債市賣壓，對利率敏感的科技與成長股持續構成壓力，市場情緒轉趨謹慎。
items.summary_en: US equities edged lower on Tuesday as Treasury yields resumed their climb to multiyear highs, denting risk appetite ahead of the Fed's rate decision. The move extended a bond-market selloff driven by sticky inflation and heavy government borrowing, keeping pressure on rate-sensitive tech and growth stocks.

items.title_zh: 30年期美債殖利率創2002年來新高（2026-09-29）
items.title_en: 30-year Treasury yield scales to highest since 2002 (2026-09-29)
items.summary_zh: 30年期美國公債殖利率升破5.6%，創2002年6月以來最高；10年期殖利率逼近5.3%、觸及2007年以來高點，債市賣壓加劇。投資人歸因於貨幣政策疑慮、能源價格居高與政府舉債攀升，市場因而加碼押注Fed將進一步升息以抑制通膨，債市動盪外溢至股匯市。
items.summary_en: The 30-year Treasury yield climbed above 5.6%—its highest since June 2002—while the 10-year neared 5.3%, a fresh 2007-era high, as the bond-market rout deepened. Investors cited monetary-policy concerns, elevated energy prices and rising government debt, fueling bets on further Fed rate hikes to tame inflation.

items.title_zh: Fed關鍵通膨數據週三登場 市場高度關注（2026-09-29）
items.title_en: Fed's key inflation gauge due Wednesday in focus (2026-09-29)
items.summary_zh: 投資人聚焦聯準會偏好的通膨指標，該數據將於週三公布，為物價壓力提供最新且最清晰的訊號。若數據高於預期，將強化市場對進一步升息的預期；反之若通膨降溫，則可望為殖利率已攀升至多年新高的債市帶來喘息空間。此數據被視為左右近期利率路徑的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Investors are turning to the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation measure, due Wednesday, for the clearest read yet on price pressures. A hotter-than-expected print would harden expectations for additional rate hikes, while any cooling could offer relief to a bond market that has sold off to multiyear-high yields.

items.title_zh: 美債殖利率與川普會晤AI高管 主導盤前焦點（2026-09-29）
items.title_en: Treasury yields and Trump's AI meeting top the pre-market agenda (2026-09-29)
items.summary_zh: 美股開盤前，市場同時消化美債殖利率再度走高，以及美國總統川普會晤AI企業高管的消息。殖利率壓力抑制了股指期貨表現，也凸顯債市賣壓與AI投資題材正共同牽動美股情緒。在Fed利率決策登場前，投資人於升息疑慮與科技成長動能之間權衡，盤前氣氛偏向審慎。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the open, markets weighed a fresh rise in Treasury yields alongside President Trump's meeting with AI executives. The yield pressure kept equity futures in check and underscored how the bond-market selloff and the AI investment theme are jointly steering sentiment across US markets heading into the Fed decision.
